audit: PROCESSING (post-farm-gate) assessment contract: frontend wizard -> FastAPI pydantic -> engine

method.direct_model_probes: 32 payloads instantiated against app.processing.models.ProcessingAssessmentRequest with .venv/Scripts/python.exe (PYTHONPATH=app), then fed to engine.process_inputs.extract_processing_inputs and engine.process_adapter._allocation without a server or LCA solve. Script: scratchpad/probe_processing.py; raw outcomes: scratchpad/probe_results.json.

headline: The wizard sends a payload that is a strict subset of the pydantic contract and validates cleanly (every key it emits exists on the backend; no unknown keys; app/test_request_schema.py:115-118 covers the happy path). The wizard cannot skip steps. However, the inputs that actually drive the result (raw material, electricity, fuel, water, waste, transport, refrigerant) are optional at every layer, so a facility assessment can be produced from a facility name, one product name, one tonnage figure and defaulted packaging. Pydantic enforces positivity only on processing_capacity, annual_production and processing_steps; every other quantity accepts 0, negative, NaN, inf and absurd magnitudes, and the engine then silently drops negatives (no error, at most a note). Free-text fields (fuel_type, unit, water_source, refrigerant_type, region) accept anything and are defaulted silently (diesel, excluded, tap water, GWP 1500, GH/CA).

D_recommendations.fix: Add numeric constraints with pydantic Field: gt=0 on RawMaterialInput.quantity_per_tonne_output (267), FuelStream.monthly_consumption (176), PackagingInfo.package_size and packaging_weight_per_unit (291-292), ProcessedProduct.economic_value (308); ge=0 on monthly_electricity_consumption (189), monthly_water_consumption (203), solid_waste_generation (222), average_transport_distance (242), annual_leakage_kg (250); ge=0, le=100 on renewable_energy_percentage (195), organic_waste_percentage (225), percentage_utilized (217), local_sourcing_percentage (241), storage_loss_percentage (234); ge=1, le=366 on operational_days_per_year (154); gt=0, le=24 on operational_hours_per_day (153). Add allow_inf_nan=False to StrictModel.model_config (app/production/models.py:27) so NaN/inf are 422. Add sane upper bounds (e.g. annual_production <= 1e7 t) or at least a 'plausibility' warning.
D_recommendations.why: Closes C3, C4, C5 at the layer a direct caller cannot bypass; the engine currently hides negatives with no error.

D_recommendations.fix: Turn free-text fields into Literals/enums shared with the frontend lists: FuelStream.fuel_type (175) -> the 12 FUEL_TYPES (schema.ts:43-46) or energy_carriers keyword set; FuelStream.unit (177) -> L|kg|m3|MJ; ProcessingWaterManagement.water_source items (202) -> WATER_SOURCES (schema.ts:59); RefrigerantManagement.refrigerant_type (249) -> validate against engine.refrigerants.REFRIGERANT_GWP100 keys (or require an explicit 'Other' with a GWP). Validate `region` (320) with engine.regions.get_region in a field_validator and reject unknown codes instead of the silent GH/CA fallback in engine/process_service.py:40-50.
D_recommendations.why: Closes C6; today an unknown fuel is silently excluded and an unknown refrigerant gets GWP 1500 with only a note.

D_recommendations.fix: Add a completeness gate: require at least one energy input (monthly_electricity_consumption > 0, a fuel stream, or processing_steps) AND, for every product, either a raw_material_inputs entry or a product_type/facility_type with a default conversion ratio (engine.conversion_ratios.default_raw_input is not None). Return 422 with field-level detail, or at minimum mark the saved result data_quality.completeness as 'screening-incomplete' and surface the engine notes (process_inputs.py:384-385, 436-437, 536-537) as structured warnings rather than free text.
D_recommendations.why: Closes C1/C2: today a facility footprint can consist solely of defaulted packaging.

D_recommendations.fix: Make ProcessedProduct.packaging required (no PackagingInfo() default) or default to 'no packaging' rather than 50 kg polypropylene bags at 0.1 kg. Same for processing_operations (322): keep the default but make the report state which blocks were defaulted.
D_recommendations.why: The server currently fabricates 2 kg PP per tonne for a product the caller described without packaging (P1).

D_recommendations.fix: Reject allocation_basis='economic' when any product lacks economic_value > 0 (mirror schema.ts:152-163) instead of the silent mass fallback in engine/process_adapter.py:70-77. Reject duplicate product names (or key allocation by id in process_adapter.py:66-67).
D_recommendations.why: Closes C7 and C8; the ISO allocation statement otherwise does not match the request.

D_recommendations.fix: (a) daysPerYear: add .int() and .max(366); hoursPerDay .max(24) (92-93). (b) superRefine: require elecKwhMonth > 0 or a fuel stream with amountMonth > 0; require rawMaterial + rawKgPerTonne when productType is 'Other' or when the (facilityType, productType) pair has no default ratio; flag rawMaterial-without-kg and kg-without-rawMaterial as errors instead of silently dropping them in the builder (326-329). (c) Unique product names. (d) Treat transportKm === 0 consistently with the other quantities, or make ReviewStep.tsx:64 show '0 km (no inbound transport)'. (e) Send form_snapshot like the farm wizard (page.tsx:106 / api.ts:478-483) so re-run/edit works for processing archives.
D_recommendations.why: Gives users the error at input time; mirrors the backend fixes so the two layers stay in step (app/test_request_schema.py:6 asks for exactly that).

D_recommendations.fix: Emit a structured warning (not just a note) whenever an input is present but non-positive, unrecognised, clamped, or excluded by the unit layer (lines 319-320, 350-352, 410-416, 445-452, 488-511, 516-533; energy_carriers.py:166-169). Surface the count of excluded/defaulted inputs in data_quality so the frontend can show it.
